blocks.title: Use subscription-backed models through one local endpoint
blocks.description: Connect your existing model subscriptions, choose their models for conversations in Vetta, and view account health and quota in one place.

blocks.content: This is a third-party integration. Provider terms, regional rules and account policies still apply. You explicitly start each OAuth flow; Vetta does not import browser cookies or credentials from other CLIs.

items.title: Upgradeable without a fork
items.description: The marketplace pins CLIProxyAPI 8.0.17 and Gemini provider 1.0.5 by release URL and SHA-256. A plugin patch can move both locks after review, without a Desktop code change.

items.title: Nine account sign-in options
items.description: Connect Gemini CLI, Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity and Devin in your browser; use device codes for Kimi Code (kimi.com), xAI, Meta Muse Code and Kimi Code (kimi.ai). A provider account and model access are required.

items.title: One model list per supplier
items.description: Accounts from the same supplier form one routing pool. Each model and protocol route appears once, while every enabled account remains available for balancing and failover.

items.title: OpenAI and Google image models
items.description: Image-capable OpenAI, Google and Antigravity routes appear as individual image models. Requests use the matching Images or generateContent adapter for text-to-image and supported image-to-image work.

items.title: Health at a glance
items.description: See request history, reported quota and cooldowns per account, and refresh credentials when needed. Model lists show upstream input and search capabilities; availability depends on your account and Vetta support.

items.title: Install and enable
items.description: The plugin downloads the two pinned assets for your OS and architecture; Vetta verifies SHA-256 again and starts the service on a dynamic loopback port.

items.title: Connect accounts
items.description: Open the CPA setup page from the sidebar and authorize a provider. Add another account at any time, or remove the old local credential before authorizing its replacement. Runtime upgrades retain connected accounts.

items.title: Sync models
items.description: Select the models you want to use in Vetta and apply. Image generation models appear in image model settings. Your selections survive restarts.

items.title: Run it from the CPA setup page
items.description: The CPA setup page in the sidebar lays every credential out as a card: its recent success and failure counts, a per-window health strip, and switches to disable, clear quota state or remove it.

blocks.content: Quota appears only when the provider supplies it; clearing local cooldowns does not increase your provider allowance. Image input in chat requires a supporting Vetta version. Audio, video and native search labels describe upstream capabilities, not available Vetta inputs or search tools. See the technical documentation for advanced configuration.
